title: Escarpment and Passage
author: Ivo Vane
blurb: Quentin Hartwell, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
